document: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
summary: RenderLessonStartT01 和同 task bundle 重试的设计已解决第2轮阻断；失败的 Registry 调用审计 buffer 被丢弃，造成 D-15 审计缺口，仍阻止 Agent 域批准。

findings.title: Failed Registry attempts discard the only task-local audit
findings.evidence: tools.Registry.Call invokes auditor for ordinary failure results; SDD says failed/incomplete bundle discards the task-local buffer and terminates without lifecycle commit. Thus say success/show_word denial, budget/schema/handler failure, or panic may have no durable/retrievable audit and no success receipt to link it to, contrary to D-15 action scope/schema/audit boundary.
findings.required_change: Define a redacted durable attempt/security audit for incomplete bundles, separate from successful lifecycle receipt linkage; preserve tool/risk/actor-task/trace/stable result class but no raw args/panic/stack. Add failure matrix proving no lifecycle state writes while audit remains queryable and privacy-safe, or specify and validate an equivalent retrieval path.

findings.title: Bundle lifetime and immutability need executable semantics
findings.evidence: Bundle reuse resolves repeat-call budget for same live task, but Go slices/raw JSON are mutable and the SDD does not state whether the bundle survives only one coordinator lifetime or HTTP/process retry.
findings.required_change: Define private/deep-copied opaque bundle lifetime. Explicitly limit same-ID rollback re-entry to same task/coordinator after proven rollback; unknown commit stays pending_unknown. Test total Registry calls remains exactly 2 across rollback and no refreshed budget/new task.
findings.rationale: This prevents mutating the audited plan or refreshing D-15's per-event tool budget across retries.
